quickUse.useWhen: A team needs durable rationale and one prepared continuation across work sessions.
quickUse.restores: The settled decision, next candidate, and continuity state required for re-entry.

threadkeeper.title: Schema publication threadkeeper
threadkeeper.centralContract: Carry reviewed schema bytes from their source owner to a public receiver while preserving version identity and a reversible handoff.

entries.title: Freeze the accepted v0.1 schema bytes
entries.summary: The reviewed source revision fixes the bytes that each receiver publishes for the v0.1 route.
entries.rationale: Exact byte identity lets teams compare the repository source, Pages projection, and Worker response without redefining the contract.
entries.reviewTrigger: Review when the contract needs a semantic change; publish that change at a new versioned route.

nextCandidates.title: Promote the reviewed bytes to the public receiver
nextCandidates.reason: The source revision and receiver route are ready for a release-bound publication step.

continuityAssessments.basis: The source contract, publication route, decision rationale, and next receiver remain explicit.
atRiskElements: The public receiver becomes available after source review and publication complete.
continuityAssessments.recommendedMove: Continue from the reviewed source revision.
